title: Three Terms and One Short Pitch
subtitle: 体育与运动 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 体育与运动（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·运动与健身）
meta: 主题语境：体育与运动（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·运动与健身）　|　核心词汇：game　|　正文 346 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 game 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1963 the coach ① played a game that no boy in the school would have named, and he said the playing was the whole of the term. The ② game, meaning the match itself and not the rule, ran three terms and stayed unnamed in the book; a game, he said, is the only thing in a school that is judged by how long it is left unnamed.

Every ③ game in that school had the same short pitch beside it, and the ④ game at the far end, meaning the one they kept for the children and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A game, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to name; the coach said the naming is the part that fills three terms.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the game was the whole of the matter, meaning the wild animals and not the match. The ⑥ game, meaning the wild animals and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody names; game, he said, is either something you play or the only word that means both a match and wild animals. He said the wild animals are the part they remember.

By 1970 the ⑦ game had become a line in a plan, and the plan had become an argument about the short pitch. The ⑧ game of the whole thing, the coach wrote in October, was one school and three terms of naming; game, he said, is either the one at the far end or the reason you learned to name. He said the naming was never mentioned.

The ⑨ game I remember is the one named in the plan, which closed in 1972 and is still described as the quietest in the school. A ⑩ game, my mother said in 1974, is the only one that improves by being named; every game, she said, is wild animals that have agreed to look like a match. She said the wild animals were the honest half.

answers.why: play a game 意为“打一场比赛”，1963 年那位教练打了一场学校里没有一位男孩肯说出名字的比赛。
game 意为“比赛”，指那一场本身而不是规则，它经过了三个学期而在簿子上没有被说出名字。
game 意为“比赛”，指学校里每一场旁边的那一场，每一场旁边都有同一块矮矮的场地。
game 意为“比赛”，指留给孩子们的那一类，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
game 意为“猎物、野味”，指一件事里人人都等却无人说破的那样东西，叔叔说这些猎物就是那件事的全部。
game 意为“猎物”，指人人都等却无人说破的那样东西而不是那场比赛，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
game 意为“比赛”，指计划里写到、被说出名字的那一场，到 1970 年这一场成了计划里的一行。
game 意为“比赛”，教练十月写道，整件事的赛事之事是一所学校和三个学期的说出名字。
game 意为“比赛”，我记得的是计划里被说出名字的那一场，1972 年结束了，至今仍被说成学校里最安静的一场。
game 为抽象总称，母亲 1974 年说，一场比赛是唯一会因为被好好说出名字而变得更好的东西。
